## Independent review — CDSFL directive exposition prune

I read the whole artifact against one test: *does the model act on this token this turn, or is it telling the model why the machinery exists?* Provenance parentheticals, ratification counts, implementation-file pointers, and empirical-motivation paragraphs fail that test uniformly — a model at inference cannot act on "round-2 unanimous 5/5" or "`bench/dm/_divergence.py`". That is the cleanest cut boundary in the file, and it recurs in §7.1, §16, §17, and §18.

### Q1 — section verdicts

- **Intro (480):** COMPRESS ~300. "The mathematical model is not theory / it is your operational specification" is motivation. Keep one line: "Compute these quantities on your own output and act on the results."
- **§1 Protocol — CORE. KEEP.**
- **§2 Output contents — CORE. KEEP.** Note only: the three "a finding without X will be rejected" paragraphs restate the mandatory blocks a second time. Redundant, but core — KEEP.
- **§3 Equation — CORE. KEEP.**
- **§4 Break-Even S* (1116):** COMPRESS ~400. The reject rule (`S_k < S* → HARD REJECT, report S_k and S*`) and the S* formula are operative; the "downward-opening parabola / Valley of Bad Fixes" narration is not acted on. Keep formula + rule + S*-floor line.
- **§5 Stopping (457):** KEEP. Already lean and operative.
- **§6 Self-Assessment in Practice — CORE (worked R_k). KEEP.**
- **§7 SEARCH/REPLACE — CORE. KEEP.**
- **§7.1 Bugzilla lifecycle (2022):** COMPRESS ~1200. The model does not run the FSM — the runner does. It acts only on the four-item "operational consequence" list (settled findings are settled; produce SEARCH/REPLACE for CONFIRMED). Cut the state-transition catalogue and the "this is the loop closure that makes the panel saturate" prose.
- **§8 Discovery/Depletion (1418):** COMPRESS ~500, and **merge with §13** — they define ρ/γ and then separately tell the model how to act on ρ/γ. Respecting constraint 2, I touch none of the γ mathematics; I only note the log-log-derivation sentence is exposition the model never computes. Keep the bands.
- **§8.1 Semantic Novelty (886):** COMPRESS ~500. Model acts on "check registry, don't restate"; the description of *how the system measures* similarity is narration.
- **§8.2 Suspicious Fast Convergence (1364):** **KEEP.** This is the highest-value non-core section — it is the only place that guards against shared-prior pseudo-corroboration, which is a direct falsification-integrity mechanism. Do not let its length fool the ablation (see Q2).
- **§9 Substrate Ceiling (1018):** COMPRESS ~500. Keep the floor exit rule (`ΔR≈0 → hard exit, ν_eff is the floor`) and the ν_eff/ν_k disambiguation note (it prevents a real conflation error). Cut "efficiency multiplier not an intelligence generator."
- **§10 Proportionality — KEEP.** Operative, lean.
- **§11 Classification — CORE. KEEP.**
- **§12 Epistemic Marking — CORE. KEEP.**
- **§13 Per-Round Data (703):** KEEP but fold into §8.
- **§14 Modular vs Monolithic (913):** COMPRESS ~300. Keep the when-to-split rule; cut "structural not cognitive" commentary.
- **§15 FFAFP — CORE. KEEP.** One-line note: the "Experiments 12–37, 0–13%→60–85%" paragraph is justification, not gate logic — but it is inside a core section, so KEEP per constraint 1.
- **§16 Stage 6 (5052):** COMPRESS ~2500. Keep the NOVELTY block format, the reduction property (c_ext=0 → Stage 5), the quadrant table, and "never collapse the triple." **CUT outright:** the Hossenfelder/Erdős anecdote, the **E-value gate subsection** (shadow-mode, explicitly *not gating* — pure future-work), and the appendix-pointer parenthetical.
- **§17 Feedback Channel (4571):** COMPRESS ~1800. Keep the four-item action precedence, the resubmission rule, and "refutation permitted with tool receipts." Cut the "logged and discarded" history, rendering-boundary internals, the toml gate name, and the implementation parenthetical.
- **§18 Divergence (7772):** COMPRESS ~4800 — largest single win. Keep Structure A / Structure B, the contrast-statement requirement, and "cosmetic rewordings rejected." Cut Popper's-two-arms framing, all runner-side threshold numbers (sibling isomorphism 0.85, near-copy 0.98, channel-assignment invariant, `_divergence.py` orthogonality contract), and the ratification/closer prose — none of it is computed by the model.

**Rough total saving: ~12,800 chars (~29%).**

**MISSING (falsification integrity):** the directive never states the project's founding rule explicitly — *tool-undecidable → escalate to human, never resolve by model agreement*. It lives in CLAUDE.md, not here. §8.2 gestures at it ("needs human verification") but there is no hard rule. Add one line. Also missing: what to do when **two tools disagree** — §17 covers tool-refutes-model only.

**HARMFUL to tool-decidability:** §16's ν_k asks the model to self-narrate a literature-novelty rationale, which invites a soft, unfalsifiable number to enter η_combined. FFAFP's `d_tool` guards `d` but nothing guards `ν_k` to tool output. Worth a gate; out of core, so flaggable.

### Q2 — falsifying the pruning method

**The metric is presence/format, the risk is severity.** Every scored dimension — format compliance, testable-falsifier *rate*, FFAFP admissibility, R_k present, alternatives *supplied* — counts structure, not quality. A cut can hold all six at 100% while quietly lowering how *severe* the falsification attempts are. The exposition most exposed to this is exactly the reasoning-shaping prose that emits no parseable token: §8.2 (suspicious convergence), §9's humility, the divergence contrast discipline. Cut them and the model still *emits* a FALSIFICATION block and *supplies* an alternative — the counter goes up — while the epistemic caution that made those blocks non-trivial is gone. **A rate-of-presence metric is structurally blind to the failure mode the exposition prevents.** This is my central objection to the plan as written: it needs a severity judge (held-out task, human spot-check of falsifier bite), not only parser counts.

**Section ablation is too coarse.** Cross-section referents exist: §18's "forbidden from crediting ν_k" and §2's NOVELTY requirement both depend on §16's decomposition. Cut §16 exposition and the survivors dangle. Worse, bisection assumes independent contributions — it cannot catch **interaction effects** where A-alone and B-alone both pass but A+B degrades; restoring one masks the pair. Dependency-map the cross-refs and ablate at chunk level, not section level.

**Statistical power.** Two runs at temp 0 (not deterministic across backends) cannot detect a small degradation in a noisy count. A single fixed task cannot exercise every flaw class the exposition guards — the lean directive overfits to that task. Need a task *set* and a pre-registered degradation threshold with power to detect it.

**Cheaper/more reliable:** the per-token "does the model act on this?" classification (Q1) already isolates the safe cuts — provenance, impl pointers, shadow-mode features — that need no ablation at all. Ablate only the *borderline* chunks, with a severity judge and the union rule. The union across models is sound and conservative; it will under-prune, which is the correct error direction.

**My single strongest disagreement with the likely panel view:** the panel will treat §18 as almost pure fat and cut it hard, validated by "alternatives supplied." I dissent — a presence-metric *rewards compliance theatre*, and §18's operative anti-theatre machinery (contrast requirement, cosmetic-rejection) is the only thing resisting it. Cut §18's volume, yes — but never validate that cut on an "alternatives supplied" count, or you will select for more theatre, not less.

VERDICT on the pruning method = SOUND-WITH-CAVEATS
CUT-LIST: §16 E-value-gate subsection; all provenance/ratification/implementation parentheticals in §7.1, §16, §17, §18; §16 Hossenfelder anecdote; §18 Popper-two-arms framing and runner-side threshold numbers
COMPRESS-LIST: Intro ~300; §4 ~400; §7.1 ~1200; §8 ~500; §8.1 ~500; §9 ~500; §14 ~300; §16 ~2500; §17 ~1800; §18 ~4800 (~12,800 total)
KEEP-VERBATIM: core untouched — §1, §2 (incl. runnable-falsifier block), §3, §6 (worked R_k), §7 (SEARCH/REPLACE), §11, §12, §15 (FFAFP gate set); §8.2 also kept as load-bearing non-core
ONE-THING: Strip §18 to Structure-A/B + contrast requirement + cosmetic-rejection and delete its runner-side threshold machinery — biggest byte win, zero loss of anything the model computes.
